themes.label: Pizza quality

themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff and owners, but some report slow, inattentive or argumentative service.

themes.label: Prices and value

The best pad thai in the city.

themes.label: Friendly professional staff
themes.text: Reviewers found the staff friendly and professional without being pretentious.
quotes: Staffs are professional but unpretentious.
Very friendly staff, great ambiance, not to mention the great presentation and flavor of the deserts.

themes.label: Ambiance and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers mention a nice ambience and lovely setting, and one found it quiet at night.
quotes: Very tasty desserts and nice ambience
The dessert bar was very quiet only 2 -3 table were taken.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices high and portions small for the cost, while others call prices reasonable or accept a pricier meal as tasty.
quotes: some dishes cost too much for the amount of food that is coming, specially dishes with seafood.
prices remain reasonable for an all-around excellent value in a foremost UES Mexican meal.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most describe friendly, attentive staff, but several report long waits, absent waiters, unhelpful managers and an attitude over billing.
quotes: Most friendly staff ever and the food is out of this world.
Waiter disappeared for 30 minutes and had to ask alternate staff to locate him/inquire about order.

themes.label: Margaritas and drinks
themes.text: Margaritas are widely praised as well made and strong, with happy hour liked, though one reviewer found the sangria watery and another a happy hour mix-up.
quotes: The margaritas were strong and very well made.
I love there margarita drinks with the chilli salt around the cup

themes.label: Guacamole and tacos
themes.text: Guacamole and fish or shrimp tacos are repeatedly singled out as excellent.
quotes: Móle makes THE BEST Shrimp Tacos (I prefer hard shell) loaded with toppings, and the Guacamole is excellent too!
They have the best guacamole I've ever tasted!

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, lively room and decor, with outdoor seating, though one notes it can get loud.
quotes: Delicious Mexican food in a cozy low lit atmosphere.
Note that it can get loud, don't come here expecting a calm, quiet atmosphere.

themes.label: Cash-only payment
themes.text: Many reviewers warn the restaurant takes only cash, with some annoyed by the lack of notice and ATM fees, though most still enjoyed the food.
quotes: CASH ONLY! CASH ONLY! CASH ONLY! CASH ONLY! (That's my only downside on this place...
Only downside is they're cash only.

themes.label: Soba and broth flavor
themes.text: Reviewers praise the soba noodles and rich, flavorful broths, especially the dipping soba and Mera Mera, though a couple found it salty, basic or oily.
quotes: The soba was clearly freshly made and the soup stock super rich in flavor.
insanely delicious and rich broth

themes.label: Japanese curry
themes.text: Most reviewers love the Japanese curry for its flavor and comfort, though one found the curry poorly cooked.
quotes: Small hole in the wall with heavenly, authentic Japanese curry.
the curry I ordered was not good

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, while others found service pushy, rushed or demanding, and one reported being ignored.
quotes: Super nice staff, really nice, cosy comfortable place, despite not looking like much from the outside.
The service is fast, but also a bit demanding for you to get in order, and get out.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Opinions split: some find prices reasonable and portions large, while others call it overpriced or say portions were small and left them hungry.
quotes: Tasty, if overpriced. Good vegan options.
those bowls are massive. Whatever you order, always get the large.

themes.label: Mala noodles and flavor
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the spicy mala noodles and noodle soups as flavorful, with good noodle texture and adjustable spice, though a few find them salty or bland.
quotes: The Mala noodles are great. I also really enjoyed the special hot dry noodles.
the savory spiciness was just right, the cilantro added a nice touch, and the noodles were perfectly cooked.

themes.label: Authenticity of the food
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food authentic Chinese or Sichuan style, but several say it is not true Chongqing style or is Americanized.
quotes: Very authentic, very delicious. Way better than the ramen nearby.
Don't expect this to be an authentic Chongqing facet.

themes.label: Portion size and value
themes.text: Reviewers disagree: some find portions large and prices fair, while others call portions small or meat sparse and the food overpriced.
quotes: It was a ton of food, so be prepared to eat lots when you come here!
The noodles are good, but the portions are paltry.

themes.label: Delivery and service speed
themes.text: Dine-in service is often called quick and friendly, but delivery and takeout drew complaints about very long waits, missing items and ignored requests.
quotes: Food is okay, but delivery takes 2 and half hours
Clean space and fast service.

themes.label: Food safety and freshness
themes.text: A few reviewers reported stomachaches or diarrhea, stale ingredients, or hair and a bug in their noodles.
quotes: There was hair and a dead bug in my noodles.
Ingredients are not fresh, diarrhea after eating for several days

themes.label: Staff friendliness and rudeness
themes.text: Reviewers split: many praise friendly, courteous baristas, while others describe rude, dismissive or inconvenienced staff and attitude when asking about orders.
quotes: Great Starbucks with an exceptionally nice staff that knows their coffee.
The barista was extremely rude. He also told me they were out of blonde roast when they clearly had it.

themes.label: Spacious seating
themes.text: Most reviewers like the large room and plenty of seats, though a few say there are few seats and it is crowded.
quotes: It's very spacious so you can almost always find somewhere to sit.
not a lot of seating, always crowded

themes.label: Long waits for orders
themes.text: Reviewers report slow service, with waits of 10 to 15 minutes or more and orders that get lost or delayed.
quotes: Took me 15 min get my order ready
I've never been able to get in and out in under 10 minutes.

themes.label: Homeless and disruptive patrons
themes.text: Several reviewers say the cafe is overrun by homeless people, loud patrons and dogs, making it unpleasant for customers.
quotes: Dirty and over run with homeless and bums just hanging out.
Loud boisterous people interfering with other customers, filthy bathroom.

themes.label: Bathroom cleanliness
themes.text: Some reviewers say the restroom is clean and available, while others call the bathroom extremely dirty or filthy.
quotes: Nice staff, neighborhood vibe, clean bathroom.

themes.label: Authentic Isan Thai flavors
themes.text: Many reviewers call the food very authentic Isan or northeastern Thai, with some saying it feels like being in Thailand.
quotes: Extremely authentic. It's like walking into a restaurant in Thailand.
Most authentic Isan food I've had outside of Thailand

themes.label: Spice level
themes.text: Most reviewers say dishes are very hot, which some love and others find overwhelming, though one found the spicy order mild.
quotes: Delicious but WARNING: Medium spicy: You'll die spicy.
The spicy was mild at best.

themes.label: Papaya salad
themes.text: Papaya salad is repeatedly named as a must-order and sometimes as the best reviewers have had.
quotes: Papaya salad is a must!!
Best papaya salad I have eaten in NYC.

themes.label: Service speed and quality
themes.text: Some reviewers found service friendly, efficient or amazing, while others noted slowness, average service, or a billing error.
quotes: service could be a bit slow. food was amazing.
Food was awesome and service is amazing.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Some found prices reasonable and portions good, while others thought it expensive for small portions.
quotes: Authentic Thai flavors and tasty dishes, reasonable prices.
Good and tasty but too noisy and a little expensive for what we eat

themes.label: Quality of the tempura
themes.text: Reviewers call the tempura light, fresh and authentic, with ingredients that keep their flavor, and many name it the best tempura in New York.
quotes: Not greasy. Not heavy. Wonderfully light and the flavor of the ingredient shines through.
The best and finest tempura I've ever had.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Chefs and staff are described as warm, attentive and engaged, making diners feel welcome and at home.
quotes: The chefs and waiters were incredibly sweet and very engaged.
The chefs have a way of making you feel at home.

themes.label: Intimate small counter
themes.text: The tiny counter with about eight seats gives a cozy, intimate dining experience that some compare to theater.
quotes: Amazing food, and super intimate setting with only seating for 8 in the whole restaurant.
It was closer to dining theater than just sitting and eating an omakase meal.

themes.label: Value for price
themes.text: Reviewers find the omakase and takeout sets good value, calling the prices reasonable or cheap for the quality and portions.
quotes: Excellent value as well for either $65 or $95 for their Tempura Omakase.
The price is very competitive for the quality of food you are getting.

themes.label: Difficult reservations
themes.text: Reviewers say booking is hard and must be done well ahead because seating is so limited.
quotes: Reservation is painful. Food is good but not worthy for reservation hassels.
The place is rather small so get your reservation before going.

themes.label: Croissants and pastries
themes.text: Croissants, chocolate croissants and other French pastries are repeatedly praised, though one reviewer found the selection small with items out of stock.
quotes: The chocolate croissants are the best - at least in the Upper East Side.
Their croissants are amazing! Service can be frosty at times, but the coffee and pastries are solid

themes.label: Authentic French atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers value the French vibe, French-speaking staff and customers, and a cozy, charming room with a fireplace.
quotes: The cafe is usually filled with customers speaking French, so it feels very authentic!
It's cozy, with a cute fireplace! And the food is excellent!

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, wonderful staff, but several others report rude, frosty or unhelpful employees.
quotes: Staff is extremely rude. Employees wouldn't even answer my questions. Awful experience.
Excellent lunch place with friendly staff

themes.label: Coffee quality
themes.text: Coffee and espresso are often called great or delicious, though two reviewers found their coffee tasted burnt.
quotes: Great croissants, and the best espresso!

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or fair, while others call the coffee, bites and pastries overpriced for the quality.
quotes: Slightly overpriced for what it is, a very small selection of pastries with several out of stock
food is good and extremely reasonable priced

themes.label: Pastries and baked goods
themes.text: Reviewers praise the croissants, eclairs, cookies, desserts and especially the bread, though one found the croissants disappointing and another found pastries less scrumptious than their reputation.
quotes: Truly the best bread you can get in New York for the price. The pastries are also delicious.
Don't forget out their croissants. They are buttery and perfection.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some find service fast, friendly and wonderful, while others report rude, inattentive or slow staff, missed items and uncleared tables.
quotes: Services was fast and very friendly.
The service at this location has deteriorated significantly.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many call prices high or steep, while others say the bread and menu are reasonably priced or good value.
quotes: Nice French food reasonably priced
menu food is overpriced though but good

themes.label: Breakfast and brunch
themes.text: Reviewers recommend the place for breakfast and brunch, calling it excellent, though one noted a crowded dining room.
quotes: Excellent food, $$, outstanding for breakfast.
An excellent place to have breakfast and to buy a delicious bread

themes.label: Onion soup
themes.text: Reviewers were disappointed by the French onion soup, calling it so-so, lacking onion or disliked.
quotes: the onion soup was just so-so, which was rather disappointing.
i toke the onion soup and i didnt like it at all.

themes.label: Ascolana stuffed fried olives
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out the fried stuffed Ascolana olives as a rare, delicious specialty, with praise for the meat and gorgonzola fillings.
quotes: Delicious Ascolane style olives stuffed with meat,fish or potatoes absolutely devine and such an Italian specialty hard to find!

themes.label: Friendly, welcoming owners
themes.text: Reviewers describe the husband-and-wife owners as warm, friendly hosts who make guests feel welcome, like being in Italy or in their home.
quotes: Really delicious food, especially the burger and bomba, and SUPER friendly owners!
making us feel like guests in their welcoming home

themes.label: Fettuccine meatballs (polpette)
themes.text: The Le Marche meatballs filled with fettuccine are praised as unique, filling and a must-try dish.
quotes: Phenomenal fettuccine ball! Genuinely authentic Italian food with a limited menu.
If you're hungry, polpette le Marche is your plate.

themes.label: Authentic regional Italian food
themes.text: Many reviewers value the food as genuinely Italian and from the Le Marche region, with specialties hard to find elsewhere in New York.
quotes: Great and authentic food with specialties you won't find anywhere else in NY.
Authentic cuisine from Marche, a beautiful region of Italy.

themes.label: Desserts and pastries
themes.text: Tiramisu, Cremini custard bites, bomba and other homemade sweets are mentioned as highlights.
quotes: but what a Tiramisu you do oh! fantastic!
the unforgettably amazing homemade pastries

themes.label: Reservations and waiting lines
themes.text: Reviewers describe chaotic reservation handling, long waits even with bookings, overbooking and no clear check-in, though a couple still liked the food.
quotes: We had a confirmed reservation at 7 last night but waited until 7:30 still couldn't get a table at all.
Waited extremely long and no one cared about you. You couldn't recognize who you should do check in.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some praise friendly, attentive staff, while others report inattentive, indifferent servers who were hard to find or neglected broth and requests.
quotes: Helped us to our seats and took our stroller to store behind the counter while we ate.
it took me at least 2mins to find a waiter every time I need something

themes.label: Fresh food and broths
themes.text: Reviewers praise fresh ingredients and flavorful soup bases, naming spicy, tomato and pork belly chicken broths, plus shrimp balls and brown sugar rice cake.
quotes: Compared to other local hot pot places, the broth here is actually much more flavorful.
Very fresh veggies and meats! The spicy soup base was tasty too!

themes.label: Decor and private rooms
themes.text: Reviewers like the spacious, upscale decor, the VIP and private rooms for groups, and the sauce bar.
quotes: The private room v1 and v2 are huge with nice decor and very posh look.
the food was fresh and sauce bar is super cool

themes.label: Price for value
themes.text: Some find prices fair or decent for the quality, while others say cost is high and service does not justify it.
quotes: The service here is not on par with the price of the food.
Good hot pot experience and fairly priced.

themes.label: Dumplings
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the dumplings (beef, shrimp, pork, vegan, steamed and fried) and the dumpling soups as among the best they have had.
quotes: the dumplings here are some of the best I've had. Traditional with a twist. Clean and not too oily.
Ordered steamed and fried dumplings and they were both phenomenal.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Staff and the owner are described as friendly, attentive, welcoming and quick, though one reviewer felt service was only mostly very good.
quotes: As soon as you walk in you are greeted. The owners are extremely nice and very attentive.
The owner/waitress was so incredibly sweet & the service was very fast.

themes.label: Kimchi and Korean dishes
themes.text: Kimchi, bibimbap, mung bean pancakes and noodle dishes are singled out as flavorful, fresh and authentic.
quotes: The brown rice was cooked perfectly and the spicy kimchi was so flavorful.
Would recommend the beef dumplings, bibimbap, and mung bean pancakes. They also bring you kimchi, which is great too!

themes.label: Clean healthy food
themes.text: Reviewers describe the food and restaurant as clean, fresh, not greasy or too salty, and healthier than nearby dumpling spots.
quotes: Nothing is greasy or overdone, everything is perfectly cooked and balanced.
definitely healthier than all of the other dumpling spots in the area

themes.label: Order and utensil problems
themes.text: One reviewer complained about missing proper utensils, grilled chicken that looked unlike its picture, and an order problem left unanswered by the restaurant.
quotes: the grilled chicken was not as pictured. Instead, it appeared to be large chunks of unseasoned white meat.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call it pricey but worth it, especially tasting and kaiseki sets; a few find it overpriced for small portions.
quotes: It's relatively expensive, but the value is incredible. $65 for kaiseki — and great food? Amazing.
Food was good, but the price is over the top.

themes.label: Atmosphere and room
themes.text: Reviewers describe a quiet, relaxing, cosy, small space with a pleasant feel, suitable for clients, dates or groups.
quotes: Nice authentic Japanese food with great quiet atmosphere. Great place to take clients.
Lovely calming atmosphere, small tasty dishes.

themes.label: Hot pot and sukiyaki
themes.text: Hot pot, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu are praised as excellent, with good beef and generous portions.
quotes: Perfect Japanese hot pot. The beef is amazing and they serve a generous portion.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most praise friendly, excellent, timely service, but some report being asked to move tables and rude, temperamental waiters.
quotes: Kaiseki and sukiyaki are excellent. The service is also excellent.
A waitress came and asked us to change to the bar to make some room for other guests.

themes.label: Small portions
themes.text: Several reviewers found dishes tiny, including sashimi, tofu, octopus and uni, though one praised generous hot pot portions.
quotes: Food was not good at all and incredibly small portioned.
each one looks to be less than 2 tbsp.. $10.

themes.label: Udon noodle texture
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the udon noodles as chewy, fresh, handmade-tasting and perfectly textured, often calling them the best udon in NYC.
quotes: these are perfectly al dente. They have a wonderful spring to them that makes each bite such a joy.
Udon noodles have a great texture - chewy and soft.

themes.label: Small cramped space, waits
themes.text: The room is described as small, cozy and minimalist, but also cramped, with waits and no reservations; some still find it worth it.
quotes: Very small place though, they pack you in like sardines.
No reservations but worth a 20 min wait.

themes.label: Broth flavor
themes.text: Broths are described as flavorful and well balanced, not too salty or greasy, though one reviewer found the curry broth heavy and salty.
quotes: Each broth is perfectly balanced. Nothing too greasy or salty.
The soup broth is extremely flavorful and there is a wide variety on the menu.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Some found staff friendly and polite, while others reported rude employees, poor service, or a mishandled waitlist.
quotes: Everyone that works there was so polite and friendly.
Not tasty at all. One of the employees is very rude

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Reviewers warn the restaurant takes only cash, though several note an ATM is available inside.
quotes: Raku is cash only, but it's definitely worth the trip to an ATM.

themes.label: Gnocchi
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out the gnocchi as the best they have had, describing it as light like pillows or clouds.
quotes: The gnocchi really are like pillows and lived up to the hype.
The best Gnocchi in New York City without question.

themes.label: Cash-only policy
themes.text: Many reviewers warn the restaurant takes only cash, usually accepting it as a minor hassle, though one lowered their rating over it.
quotes: Food was great but no credit cards + no negroni = no 5 stars
Note that they only take cash, but it's well worth the extra little hassle!

themes.label: Owner and staff warmth
themes.text: Most praise the charming, welcoming owner and attentive staff, but a few describe poor, rude service or a colder new manager.
quotes: The owner is very nice and he treats everyone like family
The owner literally came to our table WHILE WE WERE EATING & said they were closing soon in a rude manner.

themes.label: Price and minimum
themes.text: Some find it expensive with small portions or object to the $40 minimum, while others consider the prices reasonable for the quality.
quotes: Expensive but amazing food.
priced reasonably for exceptional quality!

themes.label: Small intimate dining room
themes.text: Reviewers describe a small, cozy, intimate space where reservations are needed, though one found it crowded and noisy.
quotes: Delicious food, and a small intimate restaurant!
there are only a few tables so be sure to call for a reservation ahead of time.

themes.label: Food quality and taste
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as excellent and delicious, though one found the taste did not match its appearance.
quotes: Everything looked so delicious it was hard to chose what to get. Everything I've tasted has been excellent.
just wish the taste was as good as the food look, very disappointed

themes.label: Rude staff and owner
themes.text: Several reviewers describe rude or inattentive staff and an owner who treats employees badly, though one says staff are just busy.
quotes: Worst costumer service ever , the older woman is rude as hell.
You're not going to find casual small talk because they are always so busy and there is usually a five minute wait.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Reviewers call the restaurant very expensive, including a shocking catering bill, though one says the food is worth the cost.
quotes: Very Good Foods To Go. Also Very Expensive, But Worth It.
Two hours before my party Maria called and said the total was $1200!!!!!

themes.label: Catering and delivery problems
themes.text: One reviewer had trouble getting a catering price in advance and received the delivery over an hour and a half late.
quotes: To add insult to injury my delivery was over an hour and a half late.

themes.label: Sausage and hot dog quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the sausages and hot dogs as flavorful and high quality, though a few found them not like German sausage or fatty.
quotes: Hands down, best all beef frank I've ever had.
Judging just the sausage quality, this place is probably the best.

themes.label: Vegan Beyond Sausage options
themes.text: Reviewers appreciate the Beyond Sausage and vegan options, calling them delicious and flavorful.
quotes: just ordered the vegan bratwurst and it is delicious...so flavorful Would not know it's not made with meat
Best vegan hot dogs on the upper east side!!

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, helpful, quick staff, but one reviewer waited 15 minutes without being attended to.
quotes: Food was excellent and all staff were super kind.
After 15 minutes we left without being attended to.

themes.label: Buns and pretzels
themes.text: The buns and pretzel bread are repeatedly singled out as especially good.
quotes: Worth noting the buns are insanely good.
Probably the best hot dog bun I have ever tasted

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices fair or great, while others say it is pricey, including $8 for a small beer.
quotes: It loses a star on the $8 for an 8 oz of beer in a plastic cup.
Great sausage, great prices, fun little hole in the wall.

themes.label: Spare ribs
themes.text: Ribs are the most praised dish, called the best in the city and tender and flavorful, though one reviewer found them too sweet and another tough.
quotes: Just go get ribs.... don't ask any questions... go get the ribs!
They were so flavorful and tender. Usually, when I get them at other places its so hard to eat, but here it's absolutely perfect.

themes.label: Food quality decline
themes.text: Several reviewers found the food bland, poorly cooked or not as good as before, including soggy rice, frozen-tasting dumplings and tough ribs.
quotes: How the mighty have fallen! Utterly flavorless food these days.
The shredded pork with garlic sauce was sauceless and the orange chicken is usually crispy but was doughy/flavorless tonight.

themes.label: Value and portions
themes.text: Many describe good prices, a good lunch deal and large portions, though one reviewer called the food overpriced.
quotes: Also the dishes are huge portions. You get your value for your money
Decor is super cute and modern, but the food is too overpriced and not that good

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers describe the room as nice, clean, cozy and vibrant, and higher-scale than typical Chinese restaurants.
quotes: Fancier venue than your average joint.
Great food and service. Wàrm and vibrant atmosphere.

themes.label: BBQ pork buns
themes.text: Baked BBQ pork buns are the most praised dish, called the best item, sweet and buttery, though some say the rest of the food is weaker.
quotes: The pork buns are really, really good - they're like donuts! - but the rest of the food is barely edible.
The baked BBQ pork buns are the best, IMO.

themes.label: Long waiting times
themes.text: Many report waits of an hour or two that some found not worth it, while others said it was worth it or waited little.
quotes: Good dim sum, but not worth a hour and a half wait.
There is usually a long wait, but it's worth it.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices fair or cheap for Manhattan, while others call it pricey with small portions and say Chinatown offers more for less.
quotes: Truly excellent dim sum at a reasonable price

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some praise friendly, fast, attentive staff, while others report rude hosts, order errors, slow dishes and being asked to leave.
quotes: Great food friendly staff. Good for groups.
Ridiculous wait time and hostess was rude.

themes.label: Smells and cleanliness
themes.text: A few reviewers reported unpleasant smells in the restaurant, resembling cats or waste, though one called the place clean.
quotes: The whole restaurant smelt like dirty pipe or waste or leakage
it kind of smelled like cats??

themes.label: Shaved ice and bingsu
themes.text: Reviewers praise the customizable, shareable shaved ice, especially the black sesame OG, though one found the shaved ice an epic fail and another said portions shrank.
quotes: it offers the best shaved ice (papbingsu) in Manhattan. Most places require you to get sweet red beans as part of the dish.
The OG black sesame is spectacular. Plenty to share for 2-3 people.

themes.label: Crowds and noise
themes.text: Many reviewers say the place is very busy, loud and hard to find a seat in, so it is poor for quiet conversation.
quotes: Really love the desserts and all but it's way too noisy and crowded.
You won't have a quiet, relaxing tea time here.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find prices fair and portions shareable, while others call it pricy, and one says the size shrank over the years.
quotes: Super yummy dessert options for reasonable prices.
The size definitely went down over the years for the same price.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff, but early reviews report confused waiters, a forgotten dessert and slow service.
quotes: staff are friendly and very attentive.
The waiters were totally lost couldn't understand that some of us wants to pay with cash.

themes.label: Teas and coffee drinks
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the specialty teas, milk teas and lattes, including lavender and rose flavors.
quotes: The rose petal milk tea and lavender milk tea were so good... probably the best tea I ever had.
The tapioca quality is amazing and the lattes are very strong.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, polite, attentive service, but a few later reviews report slow, poor or chaotic service.
quotes: Thought the service was great, very polite, I wasn't rushed.
Sashimi was good but service was poor. It took 45 minutes to get cut raw fish

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many reviewers find the restaurant expensive or overpriced for what is served, though a few say the quality justifies the cost.
quotes: The prices are high, but I think the quality of food and service of staff justify.
every item on the menu was about 1.5 times the price that I thought it should be for the portion size

themes.label: Small portions
themes.text: Several reviewers say portions are small, while one warns that a grilled collar dish is huge.
quotes: Portions are tiny. Food is good though
Small portions, built for smaller individuals. Great Saki menu

themes.label: Authentic grilled Japanese food
themes.text: Reviewers praise authentic, fresh, cooked Japanese food, especially grilled dishes, tofu and cod, and note it is not a sushi place.
quotes: I didn't know tofu could taste so good!
authentic japanese grill. place for cooked food - not sushi.

themes.label: Change of ownership
themes.text: Some 2019 reviewers say the restaurant changed after a new company took over, with a different menu and fewer Japanese staff.
quotes: Aburiya changed. Menu is completely different.
All the classic dishes are gone

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, courteous staff, but several describe inattentive, spotty or disappointing service, including servers gathered at the bar and a understaffed room.
quotes: Servers were gathered by the bar talking instead of checking on their tables.
Consistently friendly, welcoming service.

themes.label: Brunch menu
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy brunch dishes such as the Salmon Benedict, French toast and chicken and waffles, and call it a good brunch spot.
quotes: Salmon Benedict is my favorite bougie brunch eat of all time and theirs is PERFECT.
Absolutely loved the brunch options.

themes.label: Price for value
themes.text: Several reviewers found the prices high for what they got, citing large bills for simple dishes and costs that add up.
quotes: Way too many good options to spend $50 on a piece of French toast and a mimosa here
it's a bit overpriced though. Doesn't seem so at first glance but it really adds up.

themes.label: Burgers and fries
themes.text: Burgers, including the veggie version, and fries get repeated praise as standout items.
quotes: The burger + truffle fries are the best.
Delicious veggie burger and excellent cocktails.

themes.label: Cozy neighborhood atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe a cozy, welcoming neighborhood place that is family friendly and has a pleasant vibe.
quotes: This is a true neighborhood spot; welcoming, cozy, and delicious.
Wonderful neighborhood healthy restaurant that welcomes the whole family.

themes.label: Meat quality and freshness
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the beef as high quality, fresh and tender, with a wide selection of cuts including beef tongue.
quotes: very very fresh meats and meals you can taste the difference

We spent $95 and both of us walked away hungry.

themes.label: Loud, crowded atmosphere
themes.text: Many enjoy the lively vibe, but others find the room small, very loud, cramped or uncomfortable in temperature.
quotes: The ambience is great. It's a bit loud but not overwhelmingly so.
It's so loud, all the tables and chairs wobble and squeak

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some call it reasonable or inexpensive for the quality, while others find it pricey or poor value for the portions.
quotes: My favorite inexpensive restaurant on the LES.
A bit pricey but good for a treat yo self meal.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, helpful, efficient staff, though a few describe strained or impersonal service.
quotes: People at this location is very friendly and bathroom is always clean.
Fast and friendly service at this location! Produce is always fresh and tasty.

themes.label: Fresh healthy food
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the food as fresh, healthy and tasty, with plenty of choice among proteins, grains and vegetables.
quotes: I think the food is great quality with a lot of different options for meats, grains, and vegetables.
The food is always fresh and well seasoned. We enjoy the variety of vegetable choices.

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Many see good value and filling portions, but several say portions are too small for the price.
quotes: I think it has a good price value ratio compared to the other make your own bowl style places out there.
Portions a little small for the price.

themes.label: Food execution problems
themes.text: Some reviewers report dry, undercooked, bland or cold food, and some feel this location is weaker than other Dig Inns.
quotes: The brown rice was hard, the sweet potatoes were undercooked. My food was cold, even though I picked up within 10 minutes of placing my order.
Generally good but the salmon was pretty dry

themes.label: Quick service, small room
themes.text: Reviewers value the speed and online ordering, but note lunch rush chaos and limited seating.
quotes: although seating area is rather small so beware
order online and then pick up. very busy around lunch time. healthy, fresh food!!

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers describe rude, inattentive or slow staff and a rushed feel, while others praise friendly, helpful and quick service.
quotes: The staff service is complete garbage. They genuinely don't care about service, it's more how they can get you in and out.
always great help and friendly staff, not like all the other hipster joints.

themes.label: Congee and porridge
themes.text: Congee is widely recommended as delicious, fresh and cheap, though one reviewer found the fish congee fishy and another found the porridge too salty.
quotes: We ordered congee with preserved egg and it was really good and tasted fresh-best thing we ate here.
Porridge is very cheap, a casserole porridge for only $ 6,7, enough for two people to eat.

themes.label: Waiting times
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits for a table, even with a reservation, and advise coming early or avoiding busy times.
quotes: Busy crowded and very noisy! Long wait even with reservation!
Delicious congee and soup, but the wait is too long.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers find prices cheap or reasonable for the portions, though some complain of overpricing or raised prices.
quotes: they have EXTREMELY reasonable prices for pretty decent Chinese food in Manhattan.
they raised their prices to instate a no tip policy.

themes.label: Chicken dishes
themes.text: Whole, house and garlic chicken are singled out as excellent, with crispy skin and tender meat.
quotes: you HAVE to try the house chicken. The skin is crispy and the meat is incredibly tender.
Whole chicken here is excellent— the skin is crispy and delicious.

themes.label: Margaritas and cocktails
themes.text: Reviewers mostly praise the margaritas, sangria and other cocktails, especially at happy hour, though a few found drinks average, small or lacking punch.
quotes: The happy hour margaritas are delicious
they make some of the best cocktails in the area

themes.label: Tacos
themes.text: Tacos are widely praised as flavorful and satisfying, including the impossible-meat ones, though a few reviewers found them bland, small or too big.
quotes: Tacos are meaty and flavorful.
Just like the guacamole, small and no flavor.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, helpful staff, but some report slow, careless or disorganized service.
quotes: We had an experience with the staff that you typically only see at highest-end restaurants
good food small drinks, loud and slow service

themes.label: Ambiance and decor
themes.text: Many reviewers like the cozy, stylish atmosphere, decor and music, though one found the music too loud and another disliked the high-top tables.
quotes: It was small but cozy, lighting is dim and comfortable
I love everything about this place except for the volume of the music.

themes.label: Prices and happy hour
themes.text: Happy hour deals are popular, while several reviewers consider regular prices high for the portion sizes and flavor.
quotes: cocktails were $8 and the portions were huge
Very pricey for the small portions.

themes.label: Crispy rice crust
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the crunchy, golden rice crust on the edges of the pot, though one dislikes the hard texture.
quotes: Everybody knows that a clay pot should have crispy rice on the edges of the bowl. THIS PLACE MAKES IT RIGHT!
Crunchy flavorful rice crust is delicious.

themes.label: Friendly, attentive service
themes.text: Staff are described as friendly, helpful and attentive, though one reviewer had to ask for things more than once.
quotes: the staff are very friendly and gave us pointers on how to enjoy a ClayPot meal
Waiters were helpful and attentive and it wasn't too hot in here either during a muggy summer day.

themes.label: Waits and small space
themes.text: The place is small and crowded, and several mention waits, though some were seated quickly or with only a short wait.
quotes: A very crowded place, so definitely not for one who minds having to share some personal space.
Came on a Friday at around 6pm and there was a 15 minute wait.

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Many find prices reasonable or good value, but some say portions are small for the price or it is a bit pricey.
quotes: The price is very reasonable for the quality and quantity of food served.
the big down falls of this place is the rice and the serving size it's a joke, tiny for the price

themes.label: Watching pots being made
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy sitting at the bar and watching the cooks prepare each clay pot.
quotes: You get to watch them make your bowl, if you sit around the bar area.
The food was great and it was fun watching them make it.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious, naming dishes such as the stews, bulgogi, pork belly, pancakes and fried chicken, though a few find it average or inauthentic.
quotes: Best Korean food in Midtown! Loved every dish.
Loved the dishes here... so flavorful and unique. definitely get the fried chicken and the sesame ice cream.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Staff are described as friendly, helpful and efficient, even when the restaurant is busy.
quotes: They are sooo friendly and make fantastic suggestions.
In a super busy place, service is very friendly and super efficient.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find it overpriced or not worth the cost, while others praise lunch deals, portions and say quality justifies the price.
quotes: Food is great but it's overpriced.
For $20, I would definitely say that the portions are worth it.

themes.label: Long waits and crowds
themes.text: The restaurant is very busy, with waits of up to an hour, no reservations, and crowds that put off some visitors.
quotes: Long wait though (one hour) so plan ahead. They don't take reservations.
I think it was 20 ~ 30 minutes wait, but I had to wait 50 minutes.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the cute, cozy, modern decor and inviting atmosphere, although a couple say it is loud or noisy.
quotes: Nice atmosphere, although a bit loud.
The atmosphere is a very nice and rustic feel and the staff is super nice as well

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and good service, though a few describe rude staff, slow service or being rushed.
quotes: Super good service and friendly staff. Come at 5:30pm and there is no line with lots of the seats available.
They rushed me with a check and the waiter was rude as hell.

themes.label: Food quality and variety
themes.text: Many find the hot pot and BBQ tasty, fresh and varied, but some report a limited selection, dry beef and tired vegetables.
quotes: Food is good and fresh with a variety of meats, seafood and vegetables.
Pretty small selection, beef is very dry, and cuts are quite thick.

themes.label: Birthday celebrations
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the free birthday meal and the costumed monkey or bear who sings and dances at the table.
quotes: Free hot pot on your birthday. Service is great.
Birthday monkey is so cute hehe :3

themes.label: Value and all-you-can-eat
themes.text: Reviewers see the all-you-can-eat format as good value, with cheap beers, though some say portions are excessive or staff skimp on BBQ.
quotes: Food is totally worth the money and there is a wide variety.
Good quality and worth the money.

themes.label: Space and atmosphere
themes.text: The place is described as spacious, clean and lively and good for groups, though the basement is noisy and one visit was empty.
quotes: Okay place, super noisy in the underground diner room. It's part of the hotpot feeling, but that was too much for us.
dining area was clean (there's a basement with additional seating!)

themes.label: Food quality and dishes
themes.text: Reviewers praise the food overall, naming duck, clam soup, steak tartare, crispy potatoes and brioche, though a few found some dishes bland.
quotes: My absolutely favorite was the Clam Soup.
Duck fat potatoes are a must order with a glass of wine.

themes.label: Wine selection
themes.text: Wine list and sommelier recommendations are repeatedly described as excellent, well chosen and good value.
quotes: There is great value and variety in the wine list.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most found staff friendly, attentive and knowledgeable, but early reviews mention slow service, absent servers and a bartender making mistakes.
quotes: service was slow and at times felt absent
Staff is attentive and knowledgeable.

themes.label: Space and atmosphere
themes.text: The renovated room is called sleek, cozy and beautiful, with good vibes, though one reviewer wanted the music quieter and better curated.
quotes: the beautiful decor - sleek yet cozy
Music could be better curated and a hair lower in volume.

themes.label: Attentive personal service
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the service as impeccable, warm and personal, including hands-on owners; one reviewer found the front-of-house a bit formal.
quotes: The service is impeccable, the food is beyond amazing, and the environment as though you're dinning in someone's home--comfortable.
the best part was personalized service and attention paid to each guest

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: The food is described as delicious, beautifully presented and freshly prepared, with fish, duck, appetizers and desserts singled out.
quotes: The duck and striped bass that we ordered were freshly prepared with obviously great attention to details.
The halibut special was to die for, as well as the savory tarte appetizer.

themes.label: Wine list and pairings
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the wine list, owner recommendations and pairings, though one found the list confusing and disliked a substitution suggestion.
quotes: one of the owners is a sommelier, so we just trusted her judgement and she was spot on with her wine recommendations for us
The wine list organisation is strange and not convenient.

themes.label: Cozy, quiet atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe a warm, cozy, romantic room with well-spaced tables and conversation-friendly sound, though two noted noise.
quotes: Love the fact that there is no music and so you can talk to your friends.
Very romantic cozy ambience.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call it expensive but worth the splurge, while one felt the cost exceeded the experience and another called prices inexpensive.
quotes: Not cheap but still an amazing value. Worth every penny.
Just know it's 200+ for a couple and French style, so not huge portions.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Reviewers praise the food as excellent and delicious, naming dishes such as meatballs with spaghetti, lasagna, ravioli, branzino and lamb ragu.
quotes: Best meatballs and spaghetti in UES
Excellent food, branzino was outstanding!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Service is described as attentive, friendly and warm, with the owner and staff praised for hospitality.
quotes: Friendliest staff! Best veggie lasagna I've ever had.
The waitstaff were unusually warm and helpful.

themes.label: Tight, noisy space
themes.text: Several reviewers find the room small, cramped and loud, especially when busy, though some still say the food is worth it.
quotes: it is too narrow which means that it it also very loud.
Tables are cramped together but totally worth while!

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: The ambiance is called cozy, romantic and Italian-feeling, with art on the walls and pleasant decor.
quotes: Really nice cozy place.
still discussing the art on the walls

themes.label: Portions and delivery
themes.text: Some reviewers found portions very small, and others had poor takeout or delivery experiences with phone ordering and missed orders.
quotes: Food was delicious but the portions were minuscule.
if you are hungry, definitely don't come

themes.label: Price and portion value
themes.text: Many find it expensive for the amount of eel; some say the quality and experience justify the cost, others say it is not worth it.
quotes: definitely not worth 50 dollars for something that generic tasting and such small portion sizes
It might be a bit expensive, but it was definitely worth the experience for me.

themes.label: Eel quality and taste
themes.text: Most call the grilled eel fresh, authentic and delicious, though a few found it average, generic or overburnt.
quotes: best eel over rice ever. Great char, fresh, not overly sweet, really good.
But the eel was boring. I like Unagi but this was maybe too much.

themes.label: Closed despite reservations
themes.text: Three January 2020 reviewers booked through Open Table but found the restaurant closed on arrival, with no notice or cancellation.
quotes: We had 6:00 reservations and when we arrived at the restaurant, it was dark. Closed! No info on the door.
Reservation was made but the restaurant was closed.

themes.label: Service and organization
themes.text: Some praise attentive, friendly staff, while others report long waits, opening delays, disorganization and distracted service.
quotes: Excellent eel over rice and incredible service.
the place was a bit of a logistical mess

themes.label: Rice and side dishes
themes.text: Several reviewers criticised the rice as too moist, undercooked or below expectations, and one found the miso bland.
quotes: The rice was undercooked, the miso bland, and the whole place was disorganized.
The rice was not the quality one would expect either.

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise fresh, flavorful, authentic pizza, but some call it worse than $1 slices, disgusting or burnt.
quotes: Great pizza, flavorful sauce. I always stop here when I'm in the neighborhood and they're consistent.
You can get $1 slices better than this pizza

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most describe friendly, quick, smiling staff, while one calls service just alright and another calls it terrible.
quotes: Nice welcome, smiling staff. All the dishes chosen were excellent !!
Service was friendly and quick.

themes.label: Burnt food
themes.text: Several reviewers report burnt pizza, garlic knots or delivered items.
quotes: burnt ass pizza, burnt ass garlic knots and terrible service
Ordered two items for delivery. One missing and one burned.

themes.label: Gyros and other dishes
themes.text: Reviewers praise the gyros, including a chicken gyro with large portions, and an extensive menu beyond pizza.
quotes: Excellent Gyros for very reasonable price
Great service and food large portions today I ordered chicken Gyro with salad and french fries.
